content.short: Ionex is Plasma's trading hub, combining spot and perpetuals trading with deep liquidity.
content.description: Ionex positions itself as Plasma's trading hub, unifying spot and perpetual futures trading in one venue. Offering both in one place means a trader can hedge a spot position with perps without moving funds between protocols. It is one of the native trading venues built specifically for Plasma rather than deployed there from another chain.
